title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Post-Operative Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome Following Pediatric Percutaneous Nephrolithotripsy.
summary: Among 410 patients, postoperative SIRS incidence was 20.24%; LightGBM achieved AUC 0.8576 and F1 0.6154, outperforming two adult models in this pediatric cohort. Retrospective single-center development/validation supports prediction within this population; external validation and improved patient outcomes are not established.
ai_technology: Eight machine-learning algorithms were trained to predict postoperative SIRS after pediatric percutaneous nephrolithotripsy; LASSO and Boruta selected predictors, with SHAP interpretation.
